bullets.text: The bodies of two schoolboys who drowned in Puzhal Lake were recovered, and the office should monitor safety measures around water bodies.
A hut fire in Poonamallee caused the death of 74 animals, and the office should provide necessary relief support to the affected.
Schools in Chennai and Thiruvallur districts are declared closed due to heavy rain, and the office should watch weather updates closely.
A study links Chennai urban growth and drainage gaps to rising flood risks, and the office should review urban drainage projects.
Commuters face hardships due to poor civic amenities at the Avadi temporary bus terminus, and the office should coordinate with CMDA.
Police traced a missing eight-year-old girl from near Sriperumbudur to a children home, and the office should track child safety cases.
Chennai Mayor Priya condemned defamatory AI-generated videos of her on social media, and the office should monitor cyber policing actions.
Equinix India plans to expand its data centre capacity to 70 MW, and the office should support digital infrastructure investments.
